descriptionPlain:
About Us 🚀
 
Immutable is the world’s fastest-growing game platform, built to power the next generation of games. We aim to drive the next evolution of gaming, combining performance, digital ownership and cutting-edge technology to help games grow and succeed. At the intersection of AI-driven analytics, high-performance growth tools, and seamless digital ownership, our technology helps studios attract, engage, and scale player communities.
 
Founded in 2018, Immutable is one of Australia’s fastest companies to reach unicorn status, raising more than AUD $400M+ with a valuation of AUD $3.5B. Today, more than 700 games are building on Immutable, and industry leaders like Ubisoft have chosen us as their partner for the future of gaming.
 
Over 6 million players use Immutable Passport, our unified identity enabling frictionless cross-game experiences, and our Immutable Audience platform has become the fastest-growing SaaS product line in our history. We're scaling rapidly, backed by a global team of creators, engineers, and gamers united by one mission: to build the most valuable growth layer in gaming and redefine how games launch, scale, and succeed. 🚀


About The Role 🤔
 
Immutable is looking for a Chief of Staff to work directly with our Chief Commercial Officer, driving commercial growth and deepening our customer relationships. You will be the CCO's force multiplier and thought partner in shaping commercial strategy, running our operating rhythms, and turning priorities into coordinated execution across the full GTM motion. You'll use AI daily to build tooling and create leverage across the commercial org, driving cross-functional alignment with Product, Engineering, Design, Data and Group teams. You will own end-to-end problem-solving on what matters most for Commercial, accelerating opportunities and enabling the team to move with speed and focus.

About The Role 🤔

 
Immutable is looking for a Chief of Staff to work directly with our Chief Commercial Officer, driving commercial growth and deepening our customer relationships. You will be the CCO's force multiplier and thought partner in shaping commercial strategy, running our operating rhythms, and turning priorities into coordinated execution across the full GTM motion. You'll use AI daily to build tooling and create leverage across the commercial org, driving cross-functional alignment with Product, Engineering, Design, Data and Group teams. You will own end-to-end problem-solving on what matters most for Commercial, accelerating opportunities and enabling the team to move with speed and focus.

lists.content:
• Translate Commercial strategy and priorities into executed programs across the full commercial funnel
  • Support deals working alongside Sales and Customer Growth
  • Own commercial problem-solving end to end including across pricing, upsell and expansion motion, renewals and churn risk
  • Shape enablement and tooling from what's working in the field to make Sales and CG more effective
  • Run the commercial operating cadence and communications: goal setting and OKRs, commercialisation forums, contribution to town halls and other key rhythms
  • Lead board materials, pitch decks and preparation of other materials as required
  • Partner with GTM Ops on data integrity, reporting, analytics and forecasting, and align incentive design to strategy
  • Act as the CCO's connective tissue to Group functions and execute core activities including legal reviews and compliance, finance forecasting, and people and headcount planning
  • Assist in the planning and execution of key conferences and events that maximise meeting quality and conversion

• 3-5+ years at a top-tier strategy consultancy with a strong promotion cadence
  • Structured, hypothesis-driven problem-solving where you take an ambiguous problem from first principles to a clear plan, then drive it through execution
  • Commercial fluency and judgement with a track record working with commercial teams on projects across pricing, sales motions, upsell and expansion, and churn risk
  • Strong data, analytics and forecasting skills, turning them into narrative that drives alignment and sharper decisions toward our growth goals
  • Daily fluency with AI where you build tooling and create leverage to sharpen analysis, elevate decisions and achieve measurable commercial outcomes. 
  • A high-ownership, bias-to-action instinct and genuine customer obsession where you bring solutions and follow through with measurable commercial impact.

• Experience in gaming, SaaS, or Marketing Tech
  • Time spent operating in-house at a startup or scale-up in addition to a top-tier consulting background

Immutable is on a mission to help more games launch, grow and monetise successfully, and our Customer Growth team is central to that. lists.content:
• Plan, launch and optimise paid acquisition campaigns for game studios.
  • Set up and tune ad networks and user acquisition channels end-to-end.
  • Design and run launch growth plans for studio partners.
  • Own email, CRM and lifecycle programs that retain and re-engage players.
  • Onboard studios onto Immutable's Audience growth products.
  • Own a budget, track performance, and reallocate spend based on data.
  • Build repeatable growth playbooks that scale across multiple studios.

• Hands-on performance and paid marketing experience: you have personally run and optimised campaigns and owned the numbers.
  • Practical experience setting up and optimising ad networks or user acquisition.
  • End-to-end growth craft across paid, lifecycle, email and launch.
  • Comfort owning a budget and making data-led allocation and optimisation calls.
  • Lifecycle and retention marketing experience across email and CRM.
  • Fluency with martech tooling and onboarding customers onto growth products.
  • High autonomy and ownership: you run your patch and drive your own outcomes.
  • Strong communication and influence: you can build trust and represent Immutable credibly.
  • Comfort using AI daily to move faster on copy, creative, reporting and optimisation.

• Gaming industry or games UA background.
  • Experience across adtech, e-commerce or retail growth at pace.

lists.content:
We're hiring a Head of Legal to lead the full spectrum of regulatory and product advisory work as well as work across Commercial and Corporate matters with the Legal Risk and Compliance (LRC) team as we scale our SaaS business.

You'll lead the full spectrum of regulatory and product advisory work: privacy, financial services, AML/CTF, online safety, AI and the emerging requirements that shape our products and go-to-market.

You'll work directly with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Commercial, Growth and Group to help Immutable move quickly while staying thoughtful and responsible. And you'll partner closely with Operations to bring AI and automation into how legal actually gets delivered.

This suits a Sydney-based senior in-house counsel who operates with autonomy, judgement and pace, and who can turn complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, practical advice: what teams can do, what they can't, and what happens next.

This is a snapshot of what you'll pick up from day one. Like everything at a scale-up, it'll evolve.

What Makes This Role Different ✨

  • You'll design a modern LRC operating model from scratch, including AI-enabled workflows that put our legal function at the genuine front of how in-house teams work. Not a legacy function to tend, a new one to shape.

  • You'll get breadth most in-house roles never offer: privacy, financial services, digital assets, AML/CTF, AI regulation and online safety, all live at once, all at pace.

  • You'll have autonomy and direct access to our Founders and Executive, with the mandate to influence how the whole business moves.

    • If you want to be the person who defines what great looks like rather than inheriting it, this is the role.

We're looking for a high-performing generalist who has worked in a fast-growing, agile legal function with exposure across the full breadth of legal. Deep product and regulatory specialisation is a bonus, not a prerequisite. If you've got generalist strength and the appetite to go deep, we want to hear from you. In this role you'll:
  • Own privacy end to end: Data collection, use and storage, associated policies and procedures, and privacy-by-design advice across product, marketing consents and data sharing

  • Advise on the regulatory landscape that shapes our products: Financial services and payments, stored value and digital assets, AML/CTF, sanctions, online safety and emerging AI law, and support the controls that follow

  • Partner with Senior Leaders, Exec & Founders across Product, Engineering, Growth and Commercial to spot legal and regulatory risk early, before it becomes a blocker

  • Support existing LRC team on Commercial & Corporate legal matters, including bespoke B2B contracting, negotiations and IP. You will also have exposure to Board reporting and corporate governance.

  • Get ahead of regulatory change by identifying impact early and turning it into clear, actionable plans

  • Support product and marketing compliance across customer-facing content, lifecycle communications and campaigns

  • Give non-legal teams decision-ready advice focused on options and next steps, not long-form memos

  • Instruct and manage external counsel, including scope, timelines and budget discipline

  • Build a modern, efficient LRC function using AI, templates, playbooks, self-serve guidance and lightweight process

  • Become a trusted partner who can influence senior stakeholders toward sound, practical outcomes

lists.text: You’re a match if you have  🤝:
lists.content:
• 7 to 10 years PQE, an Australian practising certificate, and you can advise on Australian legal and regulatory requirements

  • You're a high-performing generalist from a fast-moving, agile legal function, and you're energised by going deep on new domains rather than intimidated by them. Deep product and regulatory specialisation is a bonus here, not a prerequisite

  • You've got privacy experience: product privacy, data protection, marketing consent, privacy by design, cross-border data and privacy risk management. Familiarity with both the Australian framework and GDPR is a plus

  • You've worked in-house at a scale-up, fintech, tech company or regulated business where autonomy, judgement and speed were the norm

  • You turn complex legal and regulatory concepts into clear, commercial, usable advice. People understand you the first time

  • You're risk aware, not risk averse

  • You love working alongside engineers, PMs and commercial teams, and you thrive when things move fast

  • You're collaborative and happy to flex across generalist and specialist work in a lean team, including covering during periods of leave
